name: Equinix Dallas Data Center (SV12x equivalent Texas facility)

name: Meta Bowling Green Data Center (Ohio)
details: Meta's second Ohio data center. 1,000+ skilled trade workers at peak construction. ~100 operational jobs once complete.

name: Meta Cheyenne Data Center (Wyoming)
details: Meta data center in Cheyenne, WY. 1,000+ skilled trade workers at peak construction. ~100 operational jobs.

name: CapitaLand Investment Osaka Data Center
details: CapitaLand Investment (Singapore) acquired land in Osaka for its first Japan data center. 50 MW facility. Part of broader Singapore institutional investment in Asia-Pacific data centers. ADIA (Abu Dhabi Investment Authority) also committed up to $2B for Asia-Pacific data center investments via SC Capital Partners (India, South Korea, Singapore, Australia).

name: SoftBank Osaka Sakai AI Data Center (former Sharp Factory)
details: SoftBank acquired larger portion of Sharp Sakai factory site (840,000 sqm). Converting LCD factory to OpenAI data center. Adjacent KDDI also acquired smaller portion for its 48 MW AI data center (already operational January 2026). Part of SoftBank's role in Stargate and Japan AI sovereignty push.

name: Google Skien Data Center (Norway)
details: Google's first data center campus in Norway. 200-hectare site in Gromstul area (acquired 2019), ~85 miles southwest of Oslo. Google's first entry into Norwegian market.

name: Google Westpoort Data Center (Netherlands)
details: New Google campus in Westpoort, Groningen. Part of Google's €3.8B investment in Dutch digital infrastructure. 479 MW wind energy PPA ensuring >90% carbon-free energy. Eight acres on 20-hectare campus site.

name: Google The Dalles Data Center (Oregon)
details: Google's fourth data center in The Dalles, OR. 290,000 sq ft facility planned. Planning process initiated through contractor Whiting-Turner application. Part of two-data-center agreement with local authorities.

name: Apple Private Cloud Compute – Data Center Expansion (North Carolina, Iowa, Oregon, Arizona, Nevada)
location: Multiple US States (NC, IA, OR, AZ, NV)
investment: Part of $600 billion US investment commitment (2025–2029); ~$12.72B capex FY2025
timeline: Announced February 2025; construction underway in Iowa, Nevada, and Oregon (as of August 2025)
gpu_count: Custom Apple Silicon server chips (not NVIDIA); $1B planned for NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems
details: Apple expanding Private Cloud Compute data center capacity across NC, IA, OR, AZ, and NV. All facilities powered by 100% renewable energy. Maiden, NC facility (Catawba County): 5B+ already invested, expanding; supports North American iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, iMessage, etc. Iowa: Waukee campus (2,000 acres; $1.3B when fully built, 5 data centers / 1.9M sq ft). Custom-built Apple Silicon servers shipped from Houston factory (operational October 2025) to these data centers.

name: Apple AI Server Manufacturing Facility (Houston, Texas)
timeline: Announced February 2025; operational October 2025 (ahead of schedule); Mac mini production added 2026
gpu_count: Produces Apple Silicon AI server chips (not GPUs)
details: 250,000 sq ft (expanding to 500,000 sq ft with Mac mini production). Manufactures Private Cloud Compute AI servers using Apple Silicon. 20,000 sq ft Advanced Manufacturing Center. Servers shipped to Apple data centers across the US since October 2025. Largest first-of-kind US AI server manufacturing operation. Part of Apple's $600B US investment plan.

name: Digital Realty Garland (Dallas) Campus Expansion
capacity: Not publicly specified (DFW37 = six 8MW data halls)
details: DFW37 is a 410,000 sq ft facility at 1502 Ferris Road. Broader campus at 1702 W. Campbell Road plans up to four additional buildings on 45-acre site. Wells Fargo confirmed as tenant at one building.

name: Equinix SV12x xScale Silicon Valley
details: First xScale data center in the US. Located at Equinix's Great Oaks campus in San Jose alongside 4 IBX data centers. PGIM Real Estate holds 80% equity; Equinix 20%. Part of Equinix's global xScale hyperscale program.

name: Meta AI Data Centers - US Build-Out
investment: $600B total next-generation AI data center fleet plan (November 2025); $115-135B capex projected 2026
capacity: ~500 MW Meta AI Research Center (existing); multi-GW new builds
gpu_count: ~150,000 GPUs in existing research center; new fleet under construction
details: Meta announced $600B plan for next-generation AI-ready data center fleet in November 2025. AMD signed $60B deal with Meta (5 years) for AI chips (AMD gets up to 10% stake). Meta projects $115-135B capex in 2026, up from $71B in 2025. Many data center projects kept off-balance-sheet. Signed White House Ratepayer Protection Pledge (March 2026) to self-supply power for AI data centers.

name: Google Cedar Rapids Data Center (Iowa)
details: Google's second Iowa data center at Big Cedar Industrial Center (414 acres). Part of $7B total Iowa investment announced June 2025. QTS also building at same industrial park. 20-year 75% franchise fee rebate from Alliant Energy. At least 31 full-time jobs. Site can accommodate additional data centers.

name: Stargate – Project Ludicrous (Abilene Flagship)
investment: Part of $500 billion Stargate program; Oracle/Crusoe developer
capacity: 1,200 MW (1.2 GW planned; 2 buildings operational as of Sep 2025)
timeline: Announced January 2025; 2 buildings operational September 2025; all 8 buildings by end 2026
gpu_count: NVIDIA GB200 racks; first racks delivered June 2025
details: Flagship Stargate AI campus, ~1,800 acres. 8 data center buildings total; 2 operational as of September 2025. Operated by Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). OpenAI and Oracle scrapped plans to expand to 2 GW (March 2026); Meta now in talks to lease the additional capacity. Developer: Crusoe Energy. Powers OpenAI training and inference workloads.

name: SoftBank / OpenAI Lordstown Ohio Stargate Campus
investment: Part of $500B Stargate total (site-level not disclosed)
capacity: Up to 1,500 MW (1.5 GW, together with Milam County TX)
details: SoftBank broke ground on advanced data center design in Lordstown, on track for operational in 2026. Part of Stargate initiative. SoftBank and OpenAI partnership can scale to multiple GW. One of five new Stargate sites announced September 2025.

name: SoftBank / SB Energy Milam County Texas Stargate Campus
capacity: Part of up to 1,500 MW (combined with Lordstown Ohio)
details: SB Energy (SoftBank Group subsidiary) provides powered infrastructure. Fast-build data center site. One of five new Stargate sites announced September 2025.

name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 2 AI Factory Campus
capacity: 1,000 MW total potential; 200 MW initially contracted
timeline: 200 MW phases begin coming online 2026; full 200 MW by 2027
details: 900+ acre campus. 200 MW leased to U.S. Investment Grade Hyperscaler (unnamed) under ~$5B 15-year lease. Tenant holds first right of refusal for additional 800 MW. PUE projected 1.18, near-zero water consumption. Liquid cooling.

name: Stargate – Project Jupiter (Doña Ana County)
location: Doña Ana County, New Mexico, USA
investment: $360 million direct community payments; total campus investment not disclosed
capacity: ~1,375 MW (part of 5.5 GW Oracle Stargate sites)
details: Oracle-built Stargate campus ('Project Jupiter') in southern New Mexico. 4 data center buildings planned. Dedicated microgrid powered by gas turbines with state-of-the-art emission controls. Closed-loop non-evaporative cooling. Committing $360M to Doña Ana County for schools, infrastructure, and water systems; $50M for water system repairs. ~4,000 construction jobs; ~1,500 permanent jobs.

name: EdgeConneX Japan Osaka Campus (Site 1)
timeline: Announced January 2025; construction begins early 2026; Phase 1 opens Q4 2027
gpu_count: Not disclosed (600+ kW per rack high-density capability)
details: EdgeConneX's first Japan data center. High-density Ingenuity design supporting 600+ kW per rack. AI/Cloud focused. Renewable energy powered. Part of 350 MW Japan platform.

name: Compass Datacenters DFW Campus
timeline: Five existing facilities came online 2024-2025; fully occupied by single tenant
details: Hyperscale single-tenant campus model. Compass ranked 5th-fastest growing private company (2025 Inc. 5000, 435% growth). Proprietary modular, kit-of-parts design for faster delivery. Also planning $10B Meridian, Minnesota campus (8 buildings).

name: Stargate – Frontier Campus (Shackelford County)
investment: Part of $300B Oracle-OpenAI 5-year deal; campus investment not individually disclosed
gpu_count: NVIDIA next-gen GPUs (Vera Rubin generation planned)
details: Oracle-developed Stargate campus in Shackelford County, TX. 1,200-acre campus planned with 10 data center buildings, 1.4 GW critical IT load. One of the largest and most power-dense data center campuses in the US. Part of OpenAI/Oracle's 4.5 GW additional Stargate capacity agreement.

name: Oracle Stargate – Abilene Flagship (OCI Operator)
timeline: Operational September 2025 (2 buildings); all 8 by end 2026
gpu_count: NVIDIA GB200 racks (first delivered June 2025); OCI Supercluster up to 131,072 GPUs per cluster
details: Oracle is the developer and cloud infrastructure operator of the Stargate Abilene campus. Two buildings operational as of September 2025; six more to be completed by end of 2026, total 1.2 GW. Oracle/OpenAI scrapped 600 MW expansion (March 2026); Meta in talks to lease. Partners: Crusoe Energy (developer), OpenAI (tenant/compute buyer).

name: Stargate - Abilene Campus (Oracle/OpenAI Flagship)
investment: $300B+ (part of Stargate $500B total, Oracle $300B cloud deal with OpenAI)
capacity: 800+ MW (8 buildings x ~100 MW each; potential >1 GW)
timeline: First building online June 2025; full build-out by mid-2026
gpu_count: 400,000+ GPUs total (NVIDIA GB200 NVL72, then Vera Rubin); 64,000 GB200s expected by March 2026
details: Flagship Stargate site. Oracle leases and operates; OpenAI is anchor tenant. Built by Crusoe startup. 8 data center halls, each ~100 MW. First GB200 racks deployed June 2025. Oracle to spend $40B on 400,000 NVIDIA GB200 chips for this site. Part of $500B initiative announced January 21, 2025 with SoftBank, Oracle, MGX as equity funders. Potential 600 MW expansion nearby. Expected to create 6,000+ construction jobs daily and 1,700 long-term jobs.

name: Stargate - Shackelford County Campus (Oracle/OpenAI)
investment: Part of Oracle $300B cloud contract with OpenAI
capacity: Part of 5.5 GW combined Oracle-OpenAI expansion
details: One of three new sites announced September 2025 under Oracle-OpenAI partnership. Oracle will finance and oversee construction. Part of broader $300B cloud infrastructure deal OpenAI signed with Oracle. Expected to create 25,000+ onsite jobs across all five new sites.

name: Stargate - Doña Ana County Campus (Oracle/OpenAI)
location: Doña Ana County, New Mexico, USA
investment: Part of Oracle $300B cloud contract with OpenAI
capacity: Part of 5.5 GW combined Oracle-OpenAI expansion
details: Second of three Oracle-partnership sites announced September 2025. Oracle will finance and oversee construction. Part of July 2025 agreement between Oracle and OpenAI to develop up to 4.5 GW of additional Stargate capacity.

name: Stargate - Wisconsin Campus (Oracle/Vantage/OpenAI)
investment: Part of Oracle $300B cloud contract with OpenAI
capacity: Part of 5.5 GW combined Oracle-OpenAI expansion
timeline: Announced October 22, 2025 (Midwest site confirmed as Wisconsin)
details: Originally the unnamed 'Midwest site' from the September 23, 2025 announcement; confirmed as Wisconsin on October 22, 2025 to be developed by Oracle in partnership with Vantage Data Centers.

name: Digital Realty Charlotte Campus (Moores Chapel Road)
timeline: Rezoning April 2025; multi-year buildout if approved
details: 156-acre site at 12899 Moores Chapel Road, 12 miles west of Charlotte. Up to 3M sq ft across two phases. Acquired November 2024 for $160M. Additional parcels acquired in Q1 2025.

name: Reliance Jio AI Data Centers - Jamnagar Campus
capacity: 3 GW target; 120 MW online H2 2026 (first phase)
timeline: Announced February 19, 2026; 120 MW first phase online H2 2026; multi-GW build-out through 2033
details: Mukesh Ambani (Asia's richest man) announced at India AI Impact Summit. Gigawatt-scale sovereign data centers + nationwide edge computing network. Powers from 10 GW of renewable energy (solar farms in Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh). Adani Group separately announced $100B for AI data centers by 2035. Combined Indian AI infrastructure investment exceeds $200B over next 2 years per government estimates.

name: Reliance Jio / NVIDIA AI Data Center - India
investment: Part of $110B Reliance plan; NVIDIA partnership details undisclosed
details: NVIDIA partnership with Reliance Jio to build up to 2,000 MW of AI data center capacity in India. Part of NVIDIA's global sovereign AI infrastructure push. Leverages Reliance's 10 GW renewable energy from Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh solar farms.

name: Adani AI Data Centers (Renewable-Powered)
details: Gautam Adani (India's second-richest man) announced $100B for AI data centers by 2035. All facilities to be renewable energy-powered and AI-enabled. Part of broader $200B+ Indian AI infrastructure push.

name: Brookfield AI Data Center - Strängnäs, Sweden
timeline: Announced June 2025; land allocation agreement being finalized; 10-15 year construction
details: One of Brookfield's largest AI investments in Europe. Doubles capacity of existing planned 300 MW facility. 350,000 sq m additional land. 1,000+ permanent jobs, 2,000 construction jobs. First of its kind in Sweden. Part of Swedish government national AI strategy partnership.

name: Microsoft Datacenters – El Mirage & Goodyear
investment: Not individually disclosed (part of $80B FY2025 capex)

Construction requires ~5.4 million work hours and 1,324+ peak jobs. Partnership with Estrella Mountain and Glendale Community Colleges on Datacenter Academy.

name: France AI Data Center Build-Out (Multiple - Macron Plan)
investment: $69B in FDI committed to France data centers in 2025 (highest globally); €100B+ in private investments total
capacity: 283 MW under construction in Q1 2025; 1.8 GW in early-stage pipeline
details: France attracted ~$69B in data center foreign direct investment in 2025, more than double the US. UAE's G42 pledged up to €52B in French data centers (plus €40B Italy). President Macron's strategy making France #1 globally for data center FDI in 2025. Part of €100B+ private investment program. HPE and NVIDIA also launched AI Factory Lab in France for European customers.

name: KDDI Osaka Sakai Data Center
details: 48 MW across 57,000 sqm / 4 storeys. Reuses power and cooling from former Sharp LCD factory. Water-cooling technology from KDDI Telehouse Tokyo. Supports Google Gemini AI platform. Also supports pharmaceutical and manufacturing AI, and domestic LLM development. Acquired smaller portion of Sharp Sakai site (adjacent to SoftBank's larger portion).

name: Amazon AWS Government AI Data Centers (Federal)
location: Multiple US locations (GovCloud, Top Secret, Secret regions)
gpu_count: NVIDIA AI infrastructure + AWS Trainium AI chips
details: Purpose-built government AI and HPC infrastructure across AWS Top Secret, AWS Secret, and GovCloud (US) regions. First-ever AI/HPC infrastructure for US federal agencies. Access to SageMaker AI, Bedrock, Nova, Anthropic Claude, and NVIDIA GPUs. 11,000+ government agencies served.

name: AWS Federal AI Data Centers (GovCloud / Top Secret / Secret)
capacity: ~1.3 GW across new federal AI regions
details: Amazon to spend up to $50B on AI services for US government. Expands AWS Top Secret, AWS Secret, and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. Builds advanced AI and supercomputing capacity for federal agencies. Allows agencies to build custom AI solutions. Part of broader US government AI infrastructure push backed by Trump Executive Orders.

name: Google Texas Data Centers (Armstrong & Haskell Counties)
location: Armstrong County / Haskell County, Texas, USA
capacity: 7,800+ MW new energy contracted to Texas grid
details: Three new data centers: one in Armstrong County (Texas Panhandle) and two in Haskell County (near Abilene). One Haskell site co-located with new solar and battery storage plant. Advanced air-cooling systems (zero operational water use). $30M Energy Impact Fund for Texas starting 2026. 1,700+ electrical apprentices trained by 2030. AES Corp providing energy management. Also includes expansion of Midlothian campus and Dallas cloud region.

name: Google Wilbarger County Data Center (Texas)
details: New air-cooled data center in Wilbarger County, TX. Partnership with AES Corp for energy management. Advanced air-cooling to eliminate operational water use. New clean generation brought online directly alongside the data center. Part of Google's $40B Texas commitment.

name: MGX / Aligned Data Centers Acquisition
location: Multiple locations across Americas (50 data centers)
timeline: Deal closed October 2025; regulatory approval expected H1 2026
details: Largest data center acquisition in history as of October 2025. MGX (Abu Dhabi dedicated AI investment vehicle backed by Mubadala and G42) led consortium including BlackRock Infrastructure Partners, Microsoft, Kuwait Investment Authority, and Temasek. Part of GAIIP (Global AI Infrastructure Investment Partnership) which targets $100B total investment potential. Abu Dhabi using this to integrate into foundational AI infrastructure backing future AI models.

name: Amazon AWS Mattermeade Data Center (Virginia)
location: Caroline and Spotsylvania Counties, Virginia, USA
investment: Not disclosed (part of $35B Virginia commitment through 2040)
details: Amazon's Mattermeade project. 1,143 acres across 13 parcels near I-95/Mudd Tavern Road. 11 two-story data center buildings + one office. 770 MW target by 2027. Previously known as Orrock Tech Campus (since 2023). Part of $35B Virginia commitment through 2040.

name: Amazon AWS Spain Data Center Expansion
timeline: Announced March 2026 at MWC Barcelona; through 2035
details: Amazon's largest European commitment. €33.7B ($39.82B) through 2035 to expand cloud and data center infrastructure in Spain. Adds ~€18B to prior 2024 commitment of €15.7B.

name: Stargate UK - Cobalt Park / Multiple Sites
location: Northeast England (Cobalt Park) and multiple UK sites
investment: $30B (Microsoft); $15B (NVIDIA); $5B (Google); £1.5B (CoreWeave); part of £31B UK-US Tech Prosperity Deal
capacity: UK largest supercomputer: 23,000+ NVIDIA GPUs (Microsoft); Stargate UK: 8,000-31,000 NVIDIA GPUs (OpenAI/Nscale)

gpu_count: Microsoft: 23,000+ NVIDIA GPUs; OpenAI/Nscale: initial 8,000, scaling to 31,000 GPUs (early 2026)
details: UK sovereign AI infrastructure project. OpenAI partners with Nscale (expanding at Cobalt Park in Northeast England, designated AI Growth Zone). Microsoft pledged to build UK's largest supercomputer with 23,000+ NVIDIA GPUs. NVIDIA unveiled 'AI factories' across Britain. CoreWeave committed £1.5B for UK AI innovation. UK-US Tech Prosperity Deal signed worth £31B/~$42B total. Part of broader UK government's AI industrial strategy.

name: Vantage Data Centers Frontier Campus (Stargate Texas)
timeline: Construction began; first building delivery H2 2026; full build 10 data centers
details: 1,200 acres, 10 data centers totaling 3.7M sq ft. Part of Oracle/OpenAI Stargate initiative. Liquid cooling for next-gen GPU loads. LEED certification pursued. Backed by Silver Lake and DigitalBridge. Part of combined $40B Vantage investment across Frontier and Lighthouse campuses.

name: HUMAIN AI Factory Cluster - Riyadh & Dammam
investment: $23B in strategic tech partnerships; $10B venture fund; total HUMAIN/PIF AI investment undisclosed
capacity: 500 MW (NVIDIA partnership alone); 1.9 GW by 2030; 6.6 GW by 2034
timeline: Founded May 2025; ground broken August 2025; Q2 2026 first facilities online; 50 MW by Q4 2025 then 50 MW/quarter through 2026
gpu_count: Hundreds of thousands over 5 years; initial phase: 18,000 NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell
details: HUMAIN is Saudi PIF's full-stack AI company, founded one day before Trump's visit to Saudi Arabia (May 2025). Partnerships with NVIDIA ($500 MW AI factories), AWS, AMD, Qualcomm, xAI/NVIDIA (500 MW facility), Groq. Target: 6% of global AI workload. Competing with UAE for Middle East AI leadership. Plans 3 major international-facing data center complexes. Prices targeted 30% below US. Saudi Arabia also constructing 66 GW power infrastructure. DataVolt building $5B Red Sea data center (phased from 2028).

name: Amazon AWS Pennsylvania Innovation Campuses
location: Salem Township (Luzerne County) & Falls Township (Bucks County), Pennsylvania, USA
capacity: Not disclosed (900,000 home equivalent power draw)
details: Largest private sector investment in Pennsylvania history. Salem Township: 1,200-acre site adjacent to Susquehanna Steam Electric Station nuclear plant (Talen Energy PPA); 15 data center buildings planned over a decade. Falls Township: industrial park at former steel mill site in Bucks County. 1,250 high-skilled direct jobs + thousands of construction jobs.

name: xAI MACROHARDRR (Southaven, Mississippi)
capacity: ~2,000 MW (brings combined cluster to ~2 GW total)
gpu_count: Target: 1 million total GPUs across combined Memphis-Southaven cluster
details: Third xAI data center, acquired and retrofitted existing building in Southaven, MS (114 acres). Named MACROHARDRR by Musk. Near xAI's power plant site in Southaven. Largest economic development project in Mississippi history ($20B+). 27 methane gas turbines (temporary; 41 permanent turbines applied for). SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell committed 1.2 GW of power development. Water recycling plant protecting ~4.7B gallons/year from Memphis aquifer.

name: EDGNEX (DAMAC Digital) US Data Center Phase 1 - Sunbelt

capacity: 500 MW Phase 1 (one Sunbelt, one Midwest); 2,000 MW total target

details: Dubai-based DAMAC Group's EDGNEX arm committed $20B to US data centers targeting hyperscalers and AI players. By January 2026, ~1 GW of land secured worth $12B. Sites in Ohio and New Jersey acquired; Texas under review. $20B could double based on demand. Via Edgnex digital arm.

name: G42 Stargate UAE - Phase 1 (Khazna Data Centers)

capacity: 1,000 MW (Phase 1 cluster); 5,000 MW total 5 GW campus

gpu_count: 100,000+ NVIDIA GB300 chips (200 MW phase); NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GB300 systems
details: 10-square-mile UAE-US AI Campus in Abu Dhabi. Largest AI infrastructure project outside the US. G42 (Khazna subsidiary) develops; OpenAI and Oracle operate. Zero-trust security via Cisco. Nuclear, solar, and natural gas power mix. OpenAI's first international Stargate deployment. UAE investment into US Stargate in parallel. G42 invested $900M in Cerebras mega chips for 9 US supercomputers.

name: Brookfield / Data4 France AI Infrastructure Program

capacity: 1,500 MW (1.5 GW) new capacity (tripling from 500 MW to 1,500+ MW by 2030)

Aims to become France's single largest DC market. €5B additional for data transfer, chip storage, and energy generation infrastructure. Brookfield also investing €100B+ globally across AI value chain.

name: Energy Storage Solutions Rocky Mount North Carolina Data Center
details: 900 MW, 300-acre data center and energy storage campus. County commissioners approved zoning December 2025. Twin project also planned for Fayetteville, NC.

name: Stargate - Lordstown Campus (SoftBank/OpenAI)
investment: Part of SoftBank's $19B commitment to Stargate
capacity: Up to 1.5 GW combined with Milam County TX (within 18 months)
details: Developed through OpenAI-SoftBank partnership. SoftBank has already broken ground. Advanced data center design. One of two sites that together can scale to 1.5 GW within 18 months.

investment: Part of SoftBank's $19B commitment to Stargate
capacity: Part of 1.5 GW combined with Lordstown OH
details: Developed by SB Energy (SoftBank's renewable energy subsidiary) providing powered infrastructure for a fast-build data center site. SB Energy focuses on solar and battery projects. Part of OpenAI-SoftBank partnership for up to 1.5 GW combined capacity.

Colossus 1 was in repurposed Electrolux factory in Boxtown district of Memphis, built in 122 days. Colossus 2 near Southaven, MS adjacent to natural gas power plant xAI is constructing. Third building (MACROHARDRR) purchased December 30, 2025. xAI committed to develop 1.2 GW of dedicated power via White House Ratepayer Protection Pledge. 194 PB/s interconnect bandwidth; runs jobs with 150K+ GPUs at 99% uptime.

name: AWS Japan Data Centers
details: Part of Japan's $26B+ total hyperscaler commitment. AWS committed $15.24B (largest single hyperscaler commitment in Japan). Power constraints in inner Tokyo mean 5-10 year wait for grid connections, pushing development to Osaka and outer areas. Japan AI-optimized DC market projected at 26.14% CAGR to 2030.

Responsible AI Future Foundation established jointly with MBZUAI.

Closed-loop liquid cooling. Water positive. Minimum $175M in community infrastructure upgrades. 4,000+ union construction jobs; 1,000+ long-term jobs. ~$2.7B GDP contribution. Developer: Vantage.

capacity: 2,400 MW (2.4 GW; up to 3 GW total with NIPSCO capacity)

location: Multiple US locations (Silicon Valley anchor at San Jose, CA)
capacity: 1,500+ MW (1.5 GW new US capacity at full build)

details: Four data centers on 674 acres. Part of Oracle and OpenAI's Stargate initiative. 30 minutes from Milwaukee. Closed-loop cooling, zero-emission energy capacity target. Built by Whiting-Turner, Weitz Company, Michels Corp., Turner/McCarthy JV. Thousands of union construction jobs.

name: Amazon AWS Louisiana Data Center Campuses
location: Caddo and Bossier Parishes, Northwest Louisiana, USA

details: New Google data center in Pine Island, MN. Contract with Xcel Energy covering significant new wind, solar, and battery power. Part of Google's $185B 2026 CapEx commitment. Supports AI and cloud expansion in the Midwest.

name: Google Farciennes Data Center (Belgium)
investment: $1 billion (Belgium campus); total Belgium commitment $5.8B over 2 years
timeline: Ongoing construction; part of multi-year Belgium program
details: Google's second Belgian campus at Ecopôle eco-business park. Three buildings, 53,000 sqm (570,500 sq ft) on 53-hectare site. Complements Saint-Ghislain campus (Google's first European data center, since 2009). Total Belgium commitment: $5.8B over 2 years including renewable energy partnerships.

name: Meta Beaver Dam Data Center (Wisconsin)
details: 700,000 sq ft AI data center in Beaver Dam, WI (north of Madison and Milwaukee). Part of Meta's Wisconsin expansion.

name: Oracle Netherlands Expansion (Amsterdam Region)
details: Oracle expanding OCI footprint in the Netherlands including significant AI infrastructure capacity expansion in Oracle Cloud Amsterdam Region. Sovereign cloud capabilities. Targets financial services, logistics, life sciences, energy sectors.

name: Switch Reno SuperNAP Tahoe Campus
timeline: Campus established; ongoing AI factory expansion announced 2025
details: Part of Switch's five-campus US portfolio. 1,000+ acres. AI factory construction underway under EVO design. Connected to Las Vegas via SuperLoop fiber. AI factory updates part of $3.5B total ABS issuance.

name: Stargate Norway - Kvandal/Narvik Campus
investment: $1B+ initial (each partner contributed ~$250M equity; total $1B for initial phase)
capacity: 230 MW initial build; expansion to 520 MW planned
timeline: Announced July 31, 2025; 100,000 GPUs targeted by end of 2026
details: OpenAI's first European data center and first site under 'OpenAI for Countries' programme. 50/50 joint venture between Nscale and Aker. Powered 100% by renewable hydropower. Closed-loop liquid cooling; waste heat reused by local industry. OpenAI is initial offtaker. Microsoft-Nscale-Aker also announced a $6.2B partnership for Narvik AI hub (September 2025) with Microsoft as cloud services partner.

name: Deutsche Telekom / NVIDIA Industrial AI Cloud - Berlin
capacity: Not specifically disclosed (0.5 Exaflops compute; 20 PB storage)
details: One of Europe's largest AI factories. Industrial AI Cloud 'Made in Germany' for sovereign/secure German AI. Triple partnership: Deutsche Telekom (infrastructure), NVIDIA (GPUs), SAP (Business Technology Platform). Increases Germany's AI computing power by ~50% in one step. 0.5 Exaflops compute; 20 PB storage; 4x 400 GB fiber connections. Deutsche Telekom also in discussions with Schwarz Group (Lidl owner) for separate AI gigafactory, seeking EU funding.

name: KDDI Osaka Sakai AI Data Center
details: Former Sharp LCD factory site (acquired April 2025 for JPY 10B/$68M). Built in just 6 months by reusing existing high-capacity power and cooling infrastructure. 57,000 sq m floor area across four stories. Google Gemini AI model hosted. Hybrid air and direct liquid cooling. 100% renewable energy. HPE partnership for NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 deployment.

name: Digital Realty Vernon California Data Center
investment: $48.8M land acquisition; total investment not disclosed
timeline: Land acquired; construction timeline not disclosed
details: 5-acre site at 4400-4458 Pacific Boulevard in Vernon, CA. High-density AI and cloud workloads for the LA metro. Acquired for $48.8M. Lambda Labs also operating a 21 MW cluster in Vernon (LAX01 via Prime Data Centers).

name: Google Hamina Data Center Campus (7th facility)
investment: €3.5B total (to date); €1B announced 2024 for sustainability/AI expansion
capacity: Not specifically disclosed (largest Google data center campus in Europe)
timeline: Original 2009; 7th facility construction announced 2024; ongoing expansion
details: Google's oldest European data center campus, built in former paper mill. Uses seawater from Bay of Finland for cooling. 98% carbon-free energy in 2023. Waste heat warms ~80% of local homes/businesses via district heating partnership with Haminan Energia. 7th building announced 2024. Google also announced €1B Finland sustainability/AI investment in 2024. Note: New Google Finland data center plans were put on hold in October 2025 due to potential electricity tax increase (1,400-hectare land parcel at stake).

name: CoreWeave London Docklands Data Center
gpu_count: NVIDIA H200 GPUs with Quantum-2 InfiniBand networking
details: CoreWeave's second UK data center. Hosted at Global Switch London Docklands campus. Powered entirely by renewable energy. CoreWeave's European HQ is London.

name: TikTok / ByteDance Finland Data Center
details: Leverages Finland's green energy infrastructure. Part of Nordic data center boom. Finland projects fastest Nordic growth at 9.10% CAGR through 2030. LUMI supercomputer in Kajaani (operated by CSC) runs on 100% hydropower with waste heat recovery.

name: Microsoft Fairwater – Atlanta (East US 3 Region)
timeline: Announced December 2025; East US 3 region launching early 2027
details: Microsoft's Fairwater-design AI datacenter in the Greater Atlanta Metro area. Already running advanced AI supercomputers. Will expand into the East US 3 Azure region in early 2027, designed for most advanced Azure workloads. Closed-loop cooling system deployed.

name: Microsoft North Carolina Datacenter Campus
capacity: Part of Duke Energy 4.5 GW contract
details: Microsoft inked deal with utility Duke Energy to power large-scale data center complexes in North Carolina. Duke's data center contracts totaled 4.5 GW following this agreement (up from 3 GW). Part of Microsoft's $80B FY2025 datacenter investment.

name: Microsoft Malaysia Southeast Asia 3 Datacenter Region
details: Microsoft's third Malaysia region (Southeast Asia 3), announced November 2025. Adds to Malaysia West (already live) and existing SEA regions. Next-generation cloud region for advanced AI workloads. Part of significant Asia-Pacific expansion. India South Central region (Hyderabad) also launching 2026 as part of $3B India investment.

name: Stargate – Lordstown Campus (SoftBank Ohio)
capacity: Up to 750 MW (part of 1.5 GW SoftBank sites)
timeline: Announced September 2025; SoftBank broke ground; operational target 2026
details: SoftBank-developed Stargate data center in Lordstown, OH. Advanced data center design; SoftBank broke ground in late 2025 and target operational in 2026. Part of the two SoftBank/OpenAI sites that together scale to 1.5 GW over 18 months.

name: xAI Colossus 2 (Memphis area, Tennessee)
capacity: Part of ~2 GW combined Memphis-Southaven cluster
timeline: Land acquired March 2025; came online January 2026
details: xAI's second data center facility near Memphis. Came online in January 2026. Located near natural gas power facility xAI is building. Adjacent to Southaven, MS MACROHARDRR facility. A third $659M building (312,000 sq ft, 4-story) filed for permit in March 2026 adjacent to Colossus 2 at 5414 Tulane Road.

name: Microsoft nScale AI Datacenter – Narvik, Norway
details: Microsoft announced plans with nScale and Aker JV to develop a new hyperscale AI datacenter in Narvik, Norway. Part of same announcement wave as Wisconsin Fairwater. Will use similar AI chip clusters to Wisconsin. Takes advantage of Norway's renewable energy.

name: Stargate International – Norway
timeline: Announced as part of Stargate international expansion
details: International Stargate campus targeting 230 MW capacity in Norway. Part of Stargate's international expansion alongside UK, UAE, and Argentina. Larry Ellison noted up to 20 total Stargate projects.

name: Applied Digital Delta Forge 1 AI Factory Campus
capacity: 430 MW (300 MW critical IT load initially)
timeline: Initial operations mid-2027; expandable in 2028 and beyond
details: Two 150 MW buildings spanning 500+ acres. Negotiating with investment-grade hyperscaler customer. Macquarie Commodities & Global Markets loan facility supporting development. Powered by Applied Digital's proprietary AI Factory blueprint. Waterless cooling.

name: Crusoe atNorth Iceland Data Center (ICE02 expansion)
details: 24 MW expansion at atNorth's Iceland campus. Includes NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 installation. Leverages Iceland's renewable geothermal and hydroelectric power. Crusoe's international GPU cloud expansion.

name: Lambda Labs Vernon (LAX01) AI Data Center
gpu_count: NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs for AI training and inference
details: Vernon's first AI-ready data center. Lambda leases 21 MW within Prime Data Centers' 33 MW, 242,000 sq ft LAX01 facility with six data halls. High-density GPU-accelerated environment.

name: EdgeConneX / Lambda AI Factory Chicago
details: Build-to-density, single-tenant data center for Lambda. EdgeConneX Ingenuity high-density solution supporting HPC, AI training, and inference. Hybrid cooling (liquid-to-chip direct and air cooling). Part of 30+ MW dual-city project with Atlanta.

name: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt Data Center
timeline: Construction started November 2025; Phase 1 operational spring 2027
details: At Digital Park Fechenheim. Designed for AI and high-density deployments. 8,100+ sq m. Advanced cooling systems. 100% renewable energy. Park eventually to comprise 11 interconnected data centers delivering up to 200 MW.

name: EDGNEX (DAMAC Digital) Jakarta MT Haryono Data Center (Project 1)
details: Located at MT Haryono in Jakarta's central data hub. Announced May 2024. Most interconnected data center cluster in Jakarta. Targets cloud service providers and edge nodes.

name: QTS Fayetteville Georgia Data Center
details: Bloomberg photo confirmed complex under construction in 2024. Part of QTS's $70B+ portfolio and $100B prospective pipeline.

name: DataBank AI Infrastructure Program (US Nationwide)
investment: Not publicly disclosed as single figure
details: DataBank focuses on enterprise AI infrastructure build-out. Navigating new construction challenges including liquid cooling transitions, supply chain (specialized stainless steel/copper), and specialized labor shortages (439,000+ additional workers needed in North America). Mixed air/liquid cooling facilities.

name: Princeton Digital Group Jakarta Hyperscale Campus
details: One of the largest planned hyperscale data centers in Indonesia. Construction began December 2025. Singapore-based PDG is a major Asia-Pacific data center operator backed by Warburg Pincus and others.

name: Digital Realty AMS11 Amsterdam Data Center
details: Adds 27 MW across 12,000 sq m. Increases Digital Realty's total Netherlands capacity to ~159 MW. Part of Amsterdam's rapidly growing data center market.

name: CleanArc Data Centers Caroline County Campus
capacity: 900 MW total grid capacity; 300 MW available by early 2027
timeline: Construction began 2025; first 300 MW by early 2027
details: Flagship campus for CleanArc Data Centers in Virginia. 300 MW first phase available by early 2027 with full 900 MW grid capacity.

name: HUMAIN / xAI Saudi Arabia 500 MW Data Center
timeline: Announced December 2025 at GITEX; timeline TBD
details: xAI (Elon Musk's AI startup) and HUMAIN collaboration for 500 MW data center outside Riyadh. Uses NVIDIA hardware. Adobe signed as HUMAIN's first global tenant. Part of Saudi Arabia's strategy to become world's third-largest AI provider.

name: Crusoe Blue Energy Nuclear AI Data Center (Port of Victoria TX)
details: Blue Energy and Crusoe partnership for advanced nuclear-powered AI data center at Port of Victoria, Texas. Crusoe's total data center footprint exceeds 1.6 GW under operations and construction, with 10+ GW in development pipeline.

name: HUMAIN / xAI / NVIDIA Saudi AI Data Center
location: Saudi Arabia (location not disclosed, likely near Riyadh)
details: xAI and NVIDIA deal with HUMAIN (Saudi state-backed) to build largest xAI facility outside the US. Grok chatbot to be deployed across Saudi Arabia. Under negotiation for months but delayed by AI chip export restrictions. Announced at same time as HUMAIN-Cisco and HUMAIN-AMD partnerships.

name: Singapore Jurong Island Low-Carbon Data Center Park
details: One of Singapore's largest digital infrastructure projects. Located on Jurong Island industrial/energy zone. Powered by hydrogen-ready plants, expanded battery storage, ammonia power, and solar. Singapore lifted data center construction moratorium in 2022. Total national approvals for new DC development: 1.2 GW in two new tranches. Singapore market valued at $3.25B in 2025, projected $5.11B by 2031.

name: Aker Nscale Korgen Data Center (Norway)
details: Second Aker-Nscale site in Norway (in addition to Stargate Norway in Narvik). Located on land formerly owned by power company Nordkraft. 100% renewable hydropower. Part of broader Aker-Nscale JV build-out of Nordic AI infrastructure.

name: Brookfield / Microsoft 10.5 GW Renewable Energy Deal
investment: Multi-billion (largest single corporate PPA in history)
capacity: 10,500 MW (10.5 GW) of NEW renewable energy capacity
gpu_count: N/A (energy supply deal for AI data centers)
details: Largest single corporate power purchase agreement in history. Develops 10.5 GW of entirely new renewable energy capacity in US and Europe (2026-2030). Exclusively new capacity (not buying existing green energy). Directly linked to Microsoft Azure and OpenAI services infrastructure. Includes November 2025 hydro contract (20-year PPA for Brookfield hydro plant in PJM grid region). Part of a $30B GAIIP AI infrastructure fund (September 2024) with BlackRock, GIP, and MGX. Brookfield also has separate $5B partnership with Bloom Energy for AI infrastructure (October 2025).

name: NVIDIA AI Factory Research Center - Virginia
details: NVIDIA AI Factory Research Center will host the first Vera Rubin infrastructure. Anchors NVIDIA Omniverse DSX blueprint for gigawatt-scale AI factory build-outs. Partners: Bechtel, Jacobs (construction/digital twins); Eaton, GE Vernova, Hitachi, Mitsubishi Electric, Schneider Electric, Siemens, Tesla, Trane, Vertiv (power/cooling).

name: Together AI / 5C AI Factory - Maryland & Memphis
timeline: Maryland already operational (B200 GPUs); Memphis new build (GB200/GB300), coming online 2026
gpu_count: Maryland: NVIDIA B200 GPUs; Memphis: NVIDIA GB200 and GB300 systems
details: Together AI (AI compute company) in partnership with 5C. Maryland facility already running. Memphis facility coming online in 2026. Both locations set for near-term expansion. Additional locations planned for 2026.

name: Argonne National Laboratory AI Supercomputers (Equinox + 3 systems)
company: Argonne National Laboratory / NVIDIA / US DOE
timeline: Equinox (10,000 Blackwell GPUs) expected 2026; additional systems (Tara, Minerva, Janus) announced 2025
gpu_count: Equinox: 10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs; combined systems deliver 2,200 Exaflops AI performance
details: US government-backed AI research infrastructure at Argonne. Equinox (10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs) coming 2026; interconnected with existing NVIDIA-based systems for 2,200 Exaflops total. Tara, Minerva, and Janus: three additional NVIDIA-based systems for scientific AI research. Part of NVIDIA's AI Action Plan / America's AI infrastructure initiative.

name: DOE Paducah Site AI Data Center
company: US Department of Energy (tenant companies TBD)
capacity: 100+ MW (DOE minimum threshold for eligible 'Data Center Projects')
timeline: DOE issued Request for Offers as of 2025
details: US DOE issued Request for Offers inviting US companies to build and power AI data centers on its Paducah, Kentucky federal site. Part of Trump Executive Orders (July 2025) to leverage federal land for data center development. Executive Order 14318 (July 23, 2025) accelerates federal permitting for large-scale AI data centers requiring 100+ MW. Commerce Department to offer loans, grants, tax incentives for qualifying projects ($500M+ committed capex).

name: EcoDataCenter / Penta Infra - Borlänge Sweden
details: EcoDataCenter building new facility in Borlänge on former paper mill site. Part of 50+ Nordic data centers under construction or planned. atNorth planning massive facility elsewhere in Sweden. Another developer planning to double Finland's data center capacity. Nordic market projected $7.83B by 2030 at 23% CAGR.
